faqs.q: What is the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches used for?
faqs.a: The Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches are hydraulic pulling winches for tow trucks, recovery vehicles, lorries, agricultural and forestry machines and any job that needs a horizontal pull. Seven sizes give first-layer line pulls from 2,700 daN (T27 IN) to 30,000 daN (T300) on 10 to 26 mm cable.

faqs.q: How do I read a model such as T27 IN or T300?
faqs.a: The number is the nominal pull in hundreds of daN: T27 IN is 2,700 daN on 10 mm cable, T100 is 10,000 daN on 16 mm and T300 is 30,000 daN on 26 mm. The table lists 7 models with ratio, cable speed, flow, brake torque and weight.

faqs.q: Which sizes and line pulls do the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches cover?
faqs.a: The 7 sizes run T27 IN, T36 IN, T46 IN, T60, T100, T200 and T300, with first-layer pull of 2,700 to 30,000 daN, cable speed of 12 to 4.5 m/min, oil flow of 45 to 100 L/min and weight of 50 to 420 kg.

faqs.q: How do I size a T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches recovery winch?
faqs.a: Choose on the pull it must deliver on the layer it will work from: the first layer gives the highest pull and the lowest speed. A snatch block on the casualty roughly doubles the available pull at half the cable speed, less the sheave's losses, and the truck's pump must deliver the winch's oil flow at its pulling pressure; [our guide to recovery winches for tow trucks](/blog/recovery-winch-for-tow-trucks) walks through it.

faqs.q: What pressure and flow do the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches need?
faqs.a: Working pressure is 140 to 210 bar when pulling, and oil flow runs 45 to 100 L/min by size. Keep the return-line back pressure under 5 bar and at least five wraps of cable on the drum.

faqs.q: What is the drum freewheel on the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches for?
faqs.a: It disconnects the drum from the gearbox so the operator can walk the cable out to the vehicle being recovered without running the hydraulics. It can be manual, pneumatic or hydraulic.

faqs.q: Can a T series winch be used for lifting?
faqs.a: No. They are designed and rated for horizontal pulling, and they must not be used to lift or carry people. For hoisting, use a hoisting winch from Dinamic Oil's range on the [hydraulic winches](/c/hydraulic-winches).

faqs.q: Which cable should I use with the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches?
faqs.a: Dinamic Oil recommends high-resistance 6x36 Warrington Seale IWRC cable to ISO 2408, 2,160 N/mm², right regular lay, in the diameter listed for the winch, from 10 mm on the T27 IN up to 26 mm on the T300. Options include a cable tensioner (B), a fairlead cable guide (C2) or both (C1); see the [gearbox and winch accessories](/c/gearbox-winch-accessories).

faqs.q: How are the Dinamic Oil T Series Hydraulic Towing and Recovery Winches built and can they run in Gulf summer temperatures?
faqs.a: An orbit hydraulic motor with a pilot-operated overcentre valve stops the load running back, a negative static multi-disc brake holds it, and the planetary gearbox runs in an oil bath. Dinamic Oil rates its standard units for an ambient temperature up to +40 °C. Above that, or where the unit runs continuously in direct sun, tell us the actual operating temperature so the lubricant and duty can be checked.

faqs.q: How do the T series winches compare with a winch drive such as the WD?
faqs.a: The T series is a complete pulling winch for vehicles. A rotating-case unit from the [winch drives](/c/winch-drives) is a gearbox to build into your own drum; [our guide to winch drives, motor drums and complete winches](/blog/winch-drive-vs-motor-drum-vs-complete-winch) sets out the options.
